Temperature at which the combustion products exit the combustor. Specific impulse is very strongly affected by this temperature; higher is better.|燃烧产物离开燃烧室时的温度。此温度对比冲影响很大；数值越高越好。

The actual velocity of the gas exiting the nozzle. Not to be confused with effective exhaust velocity, which is specific impulse times standard gravity.|气体离开喷管时的实际速度。不同于有效排气速度；有效排气速度等于比冲乘以标准重力加速度。
